question: Which of the following is TRUE regarding the solution of a linear programming problem (LPP) whose feasible region is bounded and has at least one feasible solution?

options.A: The optimal value (maximum or minimum) of the objective function may occur at a point inside the feasible region, but not at a vertex.
options.B: The optimal value of the objective function must occur at a vertex (corner point) of the feasible region.
options.C: The feasible region cannot have more than three vertices.
options.D: The feasible region is always unbounded.
